Substrate-limited media (see Recipes) Seahorse assay media (see Recipes) 10× drugs dilution (see Recipes)

Recipes Substrate-limited media Prepare two tubes of substrate-limited media by adding the following to two tubes of Seahorse XF RPMI, pH 7.4: Add glutamine (200 mM) to a final concentration of 1 mM. Add FBS to a concentration of 1% (v/v). To one tube, add a 1:1 mixture of BSA-conjugated linoleic acid and BSA-conjugated oleic acid to a final concentration of 2.5 mg/mL for each fatty acid. To the second tube, add BSA-only to a final concentration of 5 mg/mL to serve as a control. (As there are two fatty acids added into the fatty acid–supplemented media, the BSA concentration in the BSA-only media should be 2× for the BSA concentration to be equivalent.) Filter both tubes of substrate-limited media through a 0.22 μm filter and store at 4 °C. Seahorse assay media Prepare fatty acid–supplemented assay media by adding a 1:1 mixture of BSA-conjugated linoleic acid and BSA-conjugated oleic acid (2.5 mg/mL each) to Seahorse XF RPMI, pH 7.4 Prepare BSA-only assay media by adding 5 mg/mL of BSA to Seahorse XF RPMI, pH 7.4. Store both sets of media 4 °C. 10× drugs dilution Dilute drugs stock (10,000×) to 10× on the same day as the Seahorse assay. Oligomycin (10,000×,10 mM) Add 30 μL (10,000×) to 2,970 μL of Seahorse XF RPMI assay media. FCCP (10,000×, 15 mM) Add 30 μL (10,000×) to 2,970 μL of Seahorse XF RPMI assay media. Antimycin-A (10,000×, 10 mM) and rotenone (10,000×, 1 mM) Add 30 μL of rotenone (10,000×) and 30 μL of antimycin A (10,000×) to 2,940 μL of Seahorse XF RPMI assay media.

steps.title: Prepare cells for lipid extraction
steps.instruction: Grow HEK 293FT cells in DMEM supplemented with 8 % FBS in T75 flasks or Petri dishes until a confluent monolayer is achieved; harvest 1 × 10⁸ cells per replicate for lipid extraction.

steps.title: Pre‑chill extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Mix methanol and Milli‑Q water at a 2 : 5 (v/v) ratio and keep the solution at 4 °C before use.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Discard growth medium, add 5 mL 1× PBS at room temperature, decant or aspirate; repeat this wash two more times for a total of three washes.

steps.title: Add extraction solvent and scrape
steps.instruction: Add 560 µL pre‑chilled extraction solvent to each well, scrape the cells with a cell scraper, and transfer the suspension to a 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add MTBE and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL pre‑chilled MTBE to each tube, shake on a TissueLyzer at 30 Hz for 5 min at 4 °C; repeat the shaking cycle once more (total two cycles).

steps.title: Sonicate lysates
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in an ultrasonic cleaner pre‑filled with ice‑water and sonicate for 15 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect organic layer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 845 × g (3,000 rpm) for 15 min at 4 °C; transfer the upper MTBE layer to a new Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Dry and store extracts
steps.instruction: Evaporate the transferred MTBE layer to dryness with a vacuum evaporator at room temperature and store the dried extracts at –80 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Reconstitute dried lipids
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL isopropanol/methanol (1 : 1) to each dried sample, vortex for 30 s and sonicate for 5 min.

steps.title: Clarify reconstituted samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 20,000 × g (15,000 rpm) for 10 min at 4 °C; transfer the supernatant into an LC vial for LC‑QTOF MS analysis.

steps.title: Prepare pooled QC sample
steps.instruction: Aliquot 5 µL from each individual sample into a single vial to serve as a pooled quality‑control sample.

steps.title: Prepare LC mobile phases
steps.instruction: Mobile phase A: water/acetonitrile 60 : 40 (v/v) with 10 mM ammonium formate and 0.1 % formic acid. Mobile phase B: isopropanol/acetonitrile 90 : 10 (v/v) with 10 mM ammonium formate and 0.1 % formic acid.

steps.title: Run LC‑QTOF analysis
steps.instruction: Use an Agilent rapid resolution HT Zorbax SB‑C18 column (2.1 × 100 mm, 1.8 µm). Set autosampler at 4 °C, injection volume 5 µL, column temperature 40 °C, flow rate 0.3 mL min⁻¹. Apply gradient: 0–2 min 40 % B; 2–12 min linear increase to 100 % B; 12–15 min hold 100 % B; 15–15.5 min return to 40 % B; 15.5–20 min 40 % B. Acquire data in both ESI⁺ and ESI⁻ modes, m/z 100–1000, 2 scans s⁻¹, ion spray voltage 4,000 V, heated capillary 350 °C, drying gas 12 L min⁻¹, nebulizer 50 psi.

steps.title: Day 1: Seed cells in Seahorse plate
steps.instruction: Dilute HEK 293FT cells to 5 × 10⁵ cells mL⁻¹ and dispense 200 µL (1 × 10⁵ cells) into each well of an XFe24 cell culture plate; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Day 1: Prepare substrate‑limited and assay media
steps.instruction: For each of two tubes of Seahorse XF RPMI (pH 7.4) add glutamine stock (200 mM) to a final concentration of 1 mM and 1 % (v/v) FBS. To tube A add a 1 : 1 mixture of BSA‑conjugated linoleic acid and BSA‑conjugated oleic acid to 2.5 mg mL⁻¹ each; to tube B add BSA only to 5 mg mL⁻¹. Filter both tubes through a 0.22 µm filter and store at 4 °C. Prepare assay media analogously (fatty‑acid‑supplemented or BSA‑only).

steps.title: Day 2: Replace growth medium with substrate‑limited media
steps.instruction: Confirm >90 % confluence under a microscope. For each well, remove 150 µL growth medium and add 150 µL the appropriate substrate‑limited media (first wash). Perform a second wash by removing 150 µL and adding 200 µL substrate‑limited media, yielding a final volume of 250 µL. Perform washes gently; each condition should be set up in at least three replicates. After washes, inspect the monolayer for integrity and incubate the plate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Day 2: Hydrate sensor cartridge
steps.instruction: One day prior to the assay, fill each well of a utility plate with 1 mL XF calibrant solution, lower the sensor cartridge into the plate, and incubate in a non‑CO₂ 37 °C humidified incubator overnight.

steps.title: Day 3: Dilute drugs for injection
steps.instruction: Prepare 10× drug solutions on the day of the assay: Oligomycin – add 30 µL of 10,000× (10 mM) stock to 2,970 µL XF RPMI; FCCP – add 30 µL of 10,000× (15 mM) stock to 2,970 µL XF RPMI; Rotenone (10 mM) and Antimycin A (10 mM) – add 30 µL each to 2,940 µL XF RPMI. Load 70 µL of the oligomycin solution into Port A, 75 µL of the FCCP solution into Port B, and 85 µL of the combined rotenone/antimycin A solution into Port C of the sensor cartridge.

steps.title: Day 3: Wash cells with assay media
steps.instruction: Perform three washes: each wash remove 150 µL assay media and add 150 µL fresh assay media. After the third wash, add 275 µL assay media to reach a final volume of 375 µL per well. Allow the cells to equilibrate for at least 30 min at 5 % CO₂, 37 °C (or in a humidified chamber during transport).

steps.title: Day 3: Run Seahorse mitochondrial stress test
steps.instruction: Turn on the XF analyzer, load the sensor cartridge with the calibrant plate and run the calibration step. Replace the calibrant plate with the cell culture plate and start the Wave software mitochondrial stress test template: baseline (mix 3 min, wait 2 min, measure 3 min) ×3 cycles; inject Port A (oligomycin) and repeat mix/wait/measure ×3; inject Port B (FCCP) repeat; inject Port C (rotenone + antimycin A) repeat; end program.
